title: Homeowner's personal data enables direct identification
description: Registration data includes identifiers like name, email, and device details, allowing direct identification of the homeowner.

title: Unencrypted data transmission allows interception
description: Data sent during registration may be intercepted if not encrypted, exposing sensitive information.

title: Insecure storage leads to data disclosure
description: Home Hub may store registration data without adequate encryption, risking unauthorized access.

title: Homeowner unaware of data usage
description: Home Hub may process data beyond the scope of registration without homeowner's knowledge.

title: Guest identity linked to access event
description: The temporary access code used by the guest can be linked to their identity, enabling tracking of their access attempts.
assumptions: Code is unique per guest and logged by Home Hub
uncertainty_note: Node L.1.1 assumes direct linking; may vary if code is anonymized.

title: Access code intercepted during transmission
description: The temporary access code transmitted from guest to Home Hub could be intercepted by an attacker if not encrypted.
uncertainty_note: Node Dd.1.1 applies to interception; encryption status unknown.

title: Guest identifiable from access logs
description: Home Hub logs of access attempts may contain data that can identify the guest, such as timestamps or unique codes.
uncertainty_note: Node I.1.1 assumes direct identification; depends on log granularity.

title: Excessive Data Collection
description: Home Hub logs all motion/door/sensor events beyond what is necessary for its intended function, increasing the risk of data misuse.
assumptions: Assumes the Home Hub collects data without strict purpose limitation.

title: Lack of User Awareness
description: Users are not informed that their motion and door events are being recorded in the local log.
assumptions: Assumes no explicit consent or notification mechanism exists.

title: Unauthorized Access to Event Log
description: The local event log may be accessed by unauthorized parties, leading to disclosure of sensitive event data.
assumptions: Assumes the log lacks adequate access controls or encryption.

title: Excessive Data Retention
description: Event data is retained in the log longer than necessary, increasing the risk of misuse over time.
assumptions: Assumes no data retention policy is enforced.

title: Linkability of Events to Individuals
description: Logged motion and door events can be linked to specific individuals, enabling tracking of their movements within the home.
assumptions: Assumes event data includes timestamps and location identifiers.

title: Users unaware of video upload
description: Home Hub uploads recorded camera clips to cloud storage without explicit user consent or notification, leading to unawareness of data processing.

title: Data interception in transit
description: Video clips transmitted from Home Hub to cloud storage could be intercepted if not encrypted during upload.

title: Unauthorized access by cloud provider
description: Cloud video storage may access or process uploaded clips without proper authorization or user consent.

title: Excessive data retention
description: Cloud storage retains video clips longer than necessary for the stated purpose, increasing exposure risk.

title: Linkability via metadata
description: Metadata in video clips (e.g., timestamps, device IDs) could link data to specific users or locations.

title: Identifiability from stored data
description: Video content may contain identifiable information about individuals (e.g., faces, license plates).

title: Non-compliance with data protection laws
description: Cloud storage may not comply with applicable privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) regarding data handling.

title: Insufficient Aggregation Leading to Indirect Identification
description: Aggregated analytics data may still allow re-identification of individual users through correlation with external datasets.
assumptions: Aggregation methods may not sufficiently anonymize data.
uncertainty_note: Assumes aggregation techniques are not robust against re-identification attacks.

title: Unencrypted Data Transmission
description: Analytics data transmitted without encryption could be intercepted by unauthorized parties.
uncertainty_note: Assumes no encryption is applied during transmission.

title: Unauthorized Use of Analytics Data
description: Cloud vendor may use the data for purposes beyond the agreed scope, such as selling to third parties.
assumptions: Vendor's data usage policies are not strictly enforced.
uncertainty_note: Assumes vendor may repurpose data without explicit consent.

title: Lack of User Notification
description: Users may not be adequately informed that their aggregated data is shared with third-party vendors.
assumptions: Privacy policy does not clearly disclose this data sharing.
uncertainty_note: Assumes transparency in data sharing practices is insufficient.

title: Unauthorized access to stored video data
description: Cloud video storage may lack encryption or access controls, allowing unauthorized parties to access stored video clips.
assumptions: Assumes cloud storage security measures may be insufficient.

title: Interception of video data in transit
description: Video data transmitted between cloud storage and backend may be intercepted if not encrypted during transmission.
assumptions: Assumes transmission may lack encryption or secure protocols.

title: Improper handling of retrieved video data
description: Mobile app backend may store or log video data beyond necessary processing, leading to unauthorized access or retention.
assumptions: Assumes backend may not enforce data minimization or secure deletion.
